DrAnsay macht Gesundheitsversorgung zugänglicher. Wir haben 2018 mit dem ersten digitalen Gesundheitsservice angefangen und investieren in z.B. medizinisches Cannabis, Abnehmspritze und Men's Health.

Du arbeitest direkt im Product-/Design-Team und verantwortest die UI-Execution unserer Mobile App. Keine Endlos-Workshops. Keine Konzept-Spiralen. Du bringst visuelle Qualität auf den Screen, plattformgerecht, entwicklerfreundlich, konsistent.

  • ProtoPie oder Principle für erweiterte Prototypen

Das bieten wir

Hinweis: Das ist ein Freelance-/Contractor-Engagement. Betriebliche Benefits sind nicht Bestandteil dieses Modells. Wir sagen das lieber direkt.

Du suchst einen PR-Job in einem Startup mit echtem Impact und viel Verantwortung ab Tag eins? Als Werkstudent:in PR & Externe Kommunikation übernimmst du die komplette PR-Arbeit inhouse – von der Themenplanung über Journalist:innenkontakte bis zum Pressetext. Deine Mission bei Foodji: Beim Aufbau unserer PR inhouse bist du von Anfang an dabei: Themenplanung und Kernbotschaften entstehen gemeinsam mit dir. Kontakte zu Journalist:innen in HR/B2B/DACH werden nach und nach aufgebaut, gepflegt und dokumentiert. Storylines, Betreffzeilen, FAQ sowie Bild- und Faktenpakete entstehen im Team – inklusive Versand der Pitches und Follow-ups. Unser B2B-LinkedIn-Kanal lebt von deinem Input: Redaktionsplan, Postings, Community-Management und Reporting. Pressespiegel und Erwähnungen werden ausgewertet, Learnings gemeinsam abgeleitet. Kommunikation, Medien, PR, Marketing, BWL) Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift Sicherer Schreibstil und Freude an präziser, zielgruppengerechter Kommunikation Strukturierte, zuverlässige Arbeitsweise mit gutem Zeit- und Prioritätengefühl Sicherer Umgang mit Google Workspace/Microsoft Office Erste praktische Erfahrung in PR/Kommunikation/Marketing (z. B. Werkstudent:in, Praktikum, Hochschulprojekte) Hands-on-Mindset und Teamspirit Offenheit für neue Tools (z. B. Docs, Slides, Spreadsheets, LinkedIn) DAS BIETEN WIR DIR Office Foodji: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Perspektiven! Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam! NOCH FRAGEN? Silja freut sich auf deine Nachricht und hilft dir gerne weiter! ÜBER UNS  Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds. Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltages verbringen - in Büros im Gewerbegebiet, wo es weit und breit nichts zu Essen gibt, in einer langen Schicht im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Du findest uns auch in der Uni, am Flughafen und im Hotel und überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst. Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Durch unsere eigens entwickelte Technologieplattform optimieren wir unsere Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt haben - auf die Umwelt, auf den täglichen Alltag unserer Kunden und auf unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir Gerichte, die übrig bleiben, an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür. Als Marktführer versorgen wir täglich mit Foodji bereits Tausende Menschen deutschlandweit. Zu unseren Kunden zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal oder Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns! Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

We are looking for a Senior Technical SEO Manager to join our Marketing team in the Madrid Office. This position ensures the technical SEO integrity of our multilingual community commerce platform across nine international markets - like mydealz.de, hotukdeals, and more. It combines classic Technical SEO with solid AI, data, and automation skills to ensure that indexing, category, and reporting workflows are scalable and not manual.

Your contributions will help shape how millions of consumers interact with our platforms, guiding them to make smart, fair, and rewarding choices.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

  • Conduct technical audits, crawl/log-file analyses, and manage indexation (noindex, canonicals, robots.txt) to resolve issues on a platform with large URL volumes.
  • Strategically advance our Entity Optimization and Semantic Search capabilities through structured data (Schema.org) and internal linking to build a machine-readable Knowledge Graph.
  • Drive the technical readiness of the platform for generative search engines (GEO) and AI-powered answers (AIO), including managing AI crawlers.
  • Build and automate internal tools, apps, and monitoring workflows using an AI-first approach with tools like Claude, Lovable, v0, Cursor, and n8n.
  • Establish workflows to measure and analyze our visibility within AI answers and translate SEO goals into actionable technical requirements for Product & Tech teams.

 Your Profile:

We're looking for someone with deep experience in technical SEO for large-scale websites, who has a proven ability to leverage AI and automation to create scalable systems.

  • Proven experience working with Screaming Frog, GSC, Ahrefs/SISTRIX/SEMrush; HTML/CSS, JS rendering, Schema.org;
  • Deep understanding of entity-based search and Knowledge Graphs; AI-first building with LLMs (Claude, Lovable, etc.).
  • Nice to have: Dashboarding, database experience, programmatic SEO, and experience building agent/tooling infrastructures (n8n).
  • Experience isolating platform-wide patterns and algorithmic anomalies across all markets, distinguishing business impact from digital noise.
  • Systematically dissects root causes when algorithms change, finding creative workarounds where standard tools reach their limits.
  • Experience translating highly complex technical SEO dependencies into clear business value for Product Owners and developers.
  • Independently identifies and prioritizes high-impact actions and documents workflows to ensure team resilience.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and spoken in English; any other language is a plus

  1. TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️
    It varies from 1 to 3 interviews

*Some processes might slightly change according to needs

title: Courier HR Senior Specialist
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><p>Wolt’s Courier Employment team is building something that doesn’t really exist yet — a cross-country infrastructure for employed courier operations across multiple geographies. We sit at the intersection of operations, people, legal, and compliance, and we’re doing it largely from scratch.</p> <p>The function currently spans three countries (Finland, Germany, Croatia), each at a different stage of maturity and with different legal frameworks. Courier employment is managed in all these countries by a functional team handling strategy, structure and resources, and country-level teams focused on execution and operational excellence from the ground up.</p> <p>We operate in a fast-moving environment with a high degree of uncertainty — regulatory, operational, and structural. If you’re energised by the possibilities and want to be the person who builds the playbook, this might be the right role for you.</p> <h2>About the role</h2> <p>Croatia doesn't have an independent Courier HR operating model yet. It has support from the general employee HR team, great people working hard, manual workarounds, and a scale-up landing in the next few months that the current setup wasn't built to absorb. This role exists to establish Courier HR expertise within the function and build the processes needed while running the team's day-to-day HR operations.</p> <p>As Courier HR Senior Specialist in Croatia, you'll own the full employee lifecycle for a fast-growing courier workforce: onboarding, contracts, documentation, leave, and the HR side of a workforce that includes couriers relocating from abroad. This includes tracking of work permits and other integration and compliance related matters.&nbsp;</p> <p>You'll be supported by the function’s core team and leadership and work closely with your Courier HR Lead, the Workforce Ops team, Legal, and the sourcing agencies bringing couriers in. You'll be the most senior Courier HR operator on the ground in Croatia day-to-day — which means you'll be trusted to make independent decisions and participate actively in building foundations and standards that will apply across all markets.</p> <h2>What you'll be doing</h2> <p><strong>Employee lifecycle execution at scale</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own onboarding, contracts, documentation, and leave administration for Croatia's employed couriers, including the operational HR side of relocating couriers from abroad (documentation, work permit tracking, compliance).</li> <li>Delegating and syncing with a Tier 1 HR team that handles standard inbound tickets and manual entry.</li> <li>Build and maintain accurate employee records across HR systems as the courier base scales.</li> <li>Handle the volume and pace of onboarding waves without letting quality or compliance slip.</li> <li>Make the judgment calls on ambiguous or non-standard cases that come up, escalating appropriately to your Courier HR Lead or Legal.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Process and SOP creation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Create SOPs, checklists, and documentation in collaboration with the functional Process &amp; Systems Senior Specialist based on cross-market standards and calibrated to local requirements.</li> <li>Identify where the current setup will break under the incoming scale-up, then plan and build for it before it breaks.</li> <li>Partner with the Process &amp; Systems Senior Specialist on anything that should become a cross-country standard rather than a local fix.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-functional coordination</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the day-to-day HR point of contact for the sourcing agencies bringing couriers into Croatia, ensuring HR-side obligations (documentation, onboarding timing, permits) are met on time.</li> <li>Work with Workforce Ops to keep HR and operational onboarding in sync as waves of new couriers arrive.</li> <li>Flag structural risks early and initiate appropriate action in collaboration with your Lead and functional colleagues.</li> </ul> <h2>Our humble expectations</h2> <p>There’s no single background that defines this role — but the people who do well here tend to combine sharp analytical thinking with genuine operational curiosity. Some things that matter:</p> <ul> <li>3+ years of experience in HR operations, people operations, or workforce administration — ideally somewhere that involved real scale, strict deadlines, or a workforce with cross-border or compliance complexity.</li> <li>Experience working with foreign worker documentation, work permits, residence permits, or employment compliance processes.</li> <li>A genuine ability to operate without a finished playbook. If "there's no process for this yet" makes you anxious rather than interested, this isn't the right role.</li> <li>High attention to detail that holds up under volume and pressure — the documentation has legal weight, and the standard shouldn’t drop with rapidly increasing volume.</li> <li>Good judgment about what to decide yourself and what to escalate. This role only works if you can be trusted with ambiguity — and trusted to know your own limits within it.</li> <li>Fluency in Croatian (C1-C2) and professional level in English (B2-C2) are a requirement. Given the courier population arriving from abroad, comfort working through language and documentation barriers is a real asset — additional languages (Spanish, for instance) are a plus but not requirement.</li> <li>Ability to work in a hybrid model from our Zagreb office (4 office days, Wednesday optional work-from-home day).</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer</h2> <p>Most HR operations roles ask you to run a process well. This one asks you to build the process while running it, for a workforce that's about to grow faster than the current setup was designed for, in a market where the team is small and knowledge is yet to be mapped to documentation. You will work with a team of experts in multiple countries, giving you a unique chance to influence our strategies, standards and ways of working while constantly learning something new.</p> <p>If it sounds like the kind of challenge you would enjoy solving, and if you are inspired by the potential of directly impacting the experience of hard working individuals establishing themselves in a new country, this will be a great opportunity for you.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Please note that this is a fixed-term contract until Dec 31st 2026, with a possibility to extend to a permanent contract. We’re expecting you to be able to start working with us during August-early September.</strong></p> <p><strong>Additional benefits:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Health insurance</li> <li>A sport benefit (PassSport)</li> <li>A tax-free commuter benefit</li> <li>A monthly lunch benefit</li> <li>Wolt Credits Cashback program</li> <li>Access to the Employee Assistance Program (free, confidential mental health support) and the Cuckoo wellness app</li> </ul> <h2>Next steps</h2> <p><strong>Please submit your application and resume in English.&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>The hiring process includes conversations with the talent acquisition partner, hiring managers and a practical assignment with a final cross-functional discussion.</p> <p>If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership, and being part of a motivated team, then click below to apply and get the conversation going!</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/GoL541_xj9w" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.</span></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
As a Tax & Corporate Structuring Manager (m/f/d), you will be responsible for designing and implementing tax-efficient corporate structures that support MIRAI Power's strategic growth across Europe. Your Contribution to the Energy Transition

  • Develop and implement tax-efficient corporate structures aligned with the company’s strategic, operational and commercial objectives.
  • Advise on domestic and international tax matters, assessing the tax implications of investments, financing arrangements, new business initiatives and corporate transactions.
  • Lead the tax aspects of mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, divestitures and internal reorganizations, while supporting legal entity governance and structuring initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable tax legislation, transfer pricing requirements and reporting obligations, while proactively managing tax risks, audits and interactions with tax authorities.
  • Collaborate closely with Legal, Finance, Treasury and external advisors, monitor regulatory developments and provide recommendations to senior management on tax planning and structuring matters.

Your Profile

  • 5+ years of professional experience in tax advisory, accounting, corporate tax, audit or the energy sector.

  • Strong leadership skills combined with a hands-on mindset and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Fluent in German and English.

Flexible Work Culture: We focus on results rather than rigid rules, offering a high level of trust, autonomy, and flexibility.

Real Impact & Ownership: From day one, you will take on responsibility and have a direct influence on our projects, processes, and the future development of MIRAI Power.

Together, we’ve fulfilled over 20 million deliveries (and counting!), making us the largest direct to consumer flower business in Europe.

We announced £75 million Series D funding in 2021 and that same year acquired bloomon in The Netherlands and Bergamotte in France. Now home to a family of 3 beautiful brands, we're expanding our gifting offering to other categories like cakes, candles and cocktails. This is all part of our ambition to build Europe's #1 direct to consumer gifting destination. 

⚙️Technology at Bloom & Wild

Our Technology team of over 60 people sits right at the heart of our business. We build and maintain the solutions that power e-commerce, production and fulfilment, enabling our brands to delight our customers every day.

The Product Engineering team consists of five cross-functional squads who each lead their own business and architectural domain, and are supported by our Platform, Domain Engineering, Data and IT teams.

Our platform uses technologies including Ruby and Rails and Python/ React, backed by PostgreSQL, Fargate/ECS on AWS, and Cloud Run on GCP. It exposes APIs that are used by our multi-brand Angular webapp and our native iOS and Android mobile apps.  We’re also looking at developing new domain driven services & microservices where applicable.

Most of our team is based in the UK or The Netherlands and works in a flexible model, with choice in how often they travel to the office. Our squads meet in person at least once per quarter in order to maintain connections, collaborate on larger projects and have fun together.

You can read lots more about our technology stack and our culture over on our tech blog - Code & Wild


💻 What you’ll be doing

As a Platform Engineer you'll work across the whole of Technology (Frontend, Backend, Data Engineering, Data Science and Warehouse Tech) helping other engineers ship better, faster, and more safely. You'll split your time roughly equally between embedded engagements inside domain squads and central platform work on the shared infrastructure.

The role of an engineer is changing. AI has removed writing code as the scarce skill; the valuable engineer is the one who picks the right problems, scopes them, and owns them through to how they behave in production. This role leans into that shift. You will work with a high degree of independence and the work isn't always handed to you as ready-made tickets, so you'll have space to identify, shape and deliver on solutions end-to-end.

This includes:

  • Embedded Engagements: Partner with domain squads, shipping code and tools to directly enhance their capability and solve real problems.

  • Paved Roads: Build shared, adoption-driven infrastructure like feature flags, canary rollouts, fast builds, and CI/CD patterns. Making the easiest path the best path.

  • AI Integration: Extend AI across the engineering lifecycle (ticket generation, config authoring, incident response, code review), operating with AI as your core working mode and creating reusable patterns.

  • Core Infrastructure: Maintain and evolve shared services: AWS, GitHub, Datadog, Cloudflare, distributing ownership across the Platform team.

  • Eliminate Toil: Automate manual processes and remove friction from the developer day-to-day.

  • Enable Ownership: Coach squads on SLOs, observability, and AI tooling, ensuring they are capable of leading their production behaviour without relying on Platform.

  • Strategic Impact: Proactively identify, scope, and deliver high-leverage problems from month six onwards.


    • ✅ You’ll love this role if you…
  • Have day-to-day experience with AWS and Terraform, and the judgement to balance performance, cost, and reliability.
  • Our stack includes ECS Fargate, RDS, ElastiCache, DynamoDB, Lambda, and EventBridge.
  • Have good judgement across CI/CD and observability, comfortable with safe and reliable deployment practices (we use GitHub Actions and Terraform Cloud), and comfortable using metrics, logs, and traces to understand how applications and infrastructure behave.
  • Experience and enthusiasm using AI coding tools, or a keenness to adopt this style of working.
  • Are willing to pick up app-side stacks like Ruby and Python, and are comfortable operating inside long-lived monoliths without trying to rewrite them.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of problems (even without a ticket) you're comfortable operating in ambiguity and defining the problem before the solution.
  • A curious and innovative mindset, open to feedback and coaching, and seek out opportunities for learning and development.
  • Driven to deliver high-quality results and take initiative.
  • You love to collaborate, and are at your best when working cross-functionally with other teams.
  • You're excited about problem-solving and love to take a logical and collaborative approach to finding solutions.

    •  

    It would be great if you also have...

  • Been part of rolling out production-ownership practices across a team or organisation.

  • Experience working on an e-commerce site or in a fast-growing (preferably consumer-facing) environment.

  • Experience setting patterns that other engineers adopted without being told to.

  • Experience writing services or apps that fit into distributed architectures — working with APIs, event-driven patterns, and the contracts and practices that keep distributed systems stable.

    • You can be based in the UK, the Netherlands or elsewhere. We're flexible on what this looks like and would love to discuss how you like to work!
     
    These are some of the skills and experience we think will enable success in this role, but please don’t worry if you are missing some of these. We’re committed to building a team made up of different strengths, skills and experiences, so if you’re excited about our values, passionate about what you do and would like to join us in doing things more thoughtfully, we’d love to hear from you.

    🌟 (some of) The good stuff

    To care wildly for our customers, firstly we care wildly for our teams. We work hard to craft a culture of thoughtfulness and care, where there is a strong sense of inclusion and belonging, enabling all of our people to thrive and be successful each day.

     

    🌻 Work that works for you 

    • Flexible working : our core hours are 10-4, but outside of these hours you can start or finish your day when works best for you

    • Work Abroad for up to 45 days each year 

    • Share in our success with a choice to take equity options

    • Enhanced family leave policy and a workplace nursery scheme

    • 1 day per year to volunteer on a project that’s close to your heart

     

    🌴 Time off

    • 25 days’ holiday + your birthday and bank holidays each year

    • Flexible bank holidays - trade a bank holiday for another day that fits your beliefs, values and celebration calendar

    • Option to buy an extra 5 days’ holiday each year 

     

    🌱 Health and wellbeing

    • Health cash plan through Simplyhealth

    • Mental health support through Open Up, including access to online therapy sessions

    • Allies and champions groups

    • Mental Health First Aiders and awareness training for our managers

    • Electric car scheme

    • Cycle to work scheme

    • Our office kitchen is stocked with drinks and snacks to keep you going

    • Financial wellbeing support through Bippit

     

    🌳 Growth & Development

    • A flexible training framework for every stage of your career development through our Bloom & Learn programme

    • Mentee and mentor opportunities with our external partners, such as The Women's Association and Mentoring for Growth run by Future Founders

    • Internal & external Speaker Sessions on a variety of different inspirational topics 

     

    💐 Moments that matter

    • Social & wellbeing monthly calendar

    • Summer and End of Year events, team lunches and post-peak celebrations

    • Irresistible discounts on our products, blooms & subscriptions!

     

    🏡 Belonging at Bloom & Wild

    We know that we learn through our differences, and building a diverse team has always been central to creating the best experience for our customers.  We value all backgrounds, perspectives, ideas and experiences, and encourage everyone to share their opinions openly within our caring and inclusive team.  Our champions community actively advances our culture of inclusion and belonging, which is organised around 8 pillars of diversity. These cross-business networks offer additional opportunities for connection, education, support and celebration, and ensure that inclusivity continues to be embedded in our ways of working.  



    🫱‍🫲 Getting hired

    We’ll do everything we can to make sure your interview experience with us is a good one. It’s a 2-way process, and we’re keen to answer all of the questions you may have, so that you can be sure (and excited!) that we’ll be the right place for you.

    - Interview with some of our Platform team to get into more of the detail.

    - Show us how you work through a technical challenge, which can be a live paired whiteboard session.

    - Final chat with Steve, from our Tech leadership team.

     

    We believe in leading change for good, so if there’s anything that we can do to help throughout your application process, or if you have any feedback, please share this with us anonymously here so we can use this to improve your experience.

raw.description:
What we do. Electric Car Leasing

Why we do it. Greener. Fairer. Future.


Over the last two years, consumer growth at Octopus Electric Vehicles has accelerated fast. We’ve grown our B2C activity significantly, and we’re now looking for someone brilliant to take day-to-day ownership of our digital performance engine.

This is a hands-on role for someone who loves being close to the detail: building campaigns, digging into search query reports, spotting optimisation opportunities, improving audiences, testing creative, reporting clearly, and helping us move faster.

You’ll sit in the B2C Growth squad, reporting into the Senior Growth Marketing Manager, and will own paid digital activity across paid search, programmatic and paid social. You’ll work closely with our Content Creator, Design team, Commercial team and wider Marketing team to get campaigns live quickly, optimise performance, and unlock new areas of growth.

Paid media is the heart of this role, but you'll also own key parts of the user journey, including writing, building, and launching campaign landing pages using our web tools to ensure end-to-end performance. Over time, there may also be the opportunity to support organic social planning, scheduling, and reporting alongside our Content Creator.

This would suit someone with strong hands-on performance marketing experience, ideally from an agency or fast-paced digital environment, who is ready to step into an in-house role with more ownership, more visibility, and more chance to shape what happens next.

 


What you'll do

🚀 Own our paid digital channels: Build, manage and optimise campaigns across paid search, paid social and programmatic display, helping us reach more people ready to make the switch to electric.

 

🔍 Get properly stuck into the detail: Dive into search query reports, audiences, bids, budgets and campaign performance to spot what’s working, what’s wasting spend, and where the next opportunity is.

 

🔧 Keep the digital engine humming: Work hands-on across SA360, DV360, Campaign Manager and Meta Ads Manager, making sure campaigns are set up cleanly, tracking works, audiences flow through, and everything goes live without drama.

 

📈 Spend smartly: Help manage digital spend within agreed monthly targets, reporting regularly on pacing, CPL and performance, with clear recommendations on where to push, pause or test next.

 

🧪 Test, learn, repeat: Partner with our Content Creator and Design team to test new creative hooks, formats, audiences and messaging across paid search, paid social and programmatic.

📊 Make reporting actually useful: Turn channel data into clear, practical insight, helping the B2C squad understand what’s happening, why, and what we should do next.

🌐 Own landing page launches & web optimisations: Take end-to-end ownership when campaigns require new landing pages and other pieces of content like quizzes, drafting page copy (with support from the team), building them using our CMS/web tools, and setting them live.

🤝 Make things happen: Coordinate briefs, assets, links, tracking and launches across content, design, web and wider marketing teams so campaigns get live quickly and with as little faff as possible. You’ll also be happy jumping into wider growth priorities when the team needs it.

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. raw.title: Sales Director
raw.description:
Life at Plume

At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life's moments better. Which is why we've built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale.

We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We're expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data. 

With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can't do it exceptionally well, we don't do it. It's how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it's how we're reinventing what's possible every day.

Role Description:

The Sales Director is responsible for building client relationships within a specified segment. Individuals who excel in this role must have the ability to prospect via email, phone, and through the partner ecosystem, develop qualified opportunities, and close business in a timely manner while staying focused on the client's requirements. The person in this position should have the ability and confidence to close deals and ensure a smooth handoff to the appropriate teams after deal closure. This role reports directly to the Senior Vice President, Sales for EMEA.

This is a unique opportunity to contribute in a meaningful way to high-visibility, high-impact projects at an exciting time for the company. Plume is an innovative, high-growth, customer-focused business in a large and growing market. If you are an energetic, self-managed professional with experience managing complex sales processes and a strong track record of meeting or exceeding your sales quota, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities:

  • Achieve sales quotas for allocated accounts on a quarterly and annual basis by developing a sales strategy in the assigned territory with a target prospect list and regional sales plan
  • Develop marketing plans with the marketing team to drive revenue growth
  • Be the trusted advisor to the customer by understanding their existing and future IT roadmap to drive the Plume solution within the marketplace
  • Qualify prospects, build new opportunities, and develop ongoing revenue streams
  • Arrange and conduct initial Executive and C-suite discussions and positioning meetings
  • Own and manage the full sales process through to close
  • Provide ongoing account management to ensure customer satisfaction and identify further revenue opportunities
  • Apply a consultative solution-based sales approach, manage complex sales cycles, and demonstrate strong presentation, listening, and organizational skills

Qualifications:

  • 5–8+ years of full-cycle, consultative sales experience, ideally selling software or cloud-based solutions to the mid-market
  • Background in cloud, ICT, software, or SaaS is preferred; experience selling to ISPs is a strong plus
  • Proven success in consistently achieving or exceeding a $1M+ ARR quota
  • Strong track record of driving pipeline, maintaining high activity levels, and closing deals
  • Skilled at identifying customer needs and presenting tailored solutions
  • Proactive, independent, and highly motivated with a positive attitude
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly within the assigned territory and occasionally across the US
  • Experience using and applying MEDDPICC or a similar sales methodology

 

About Plume

As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world's largest such as Comcast, Charter, Liberty Global, and J:COM. 

Using OpenSync, the most widely supported open-source, silicon-to-cloud framework for smart spaces, Plume's software-defined network allows ISPs to decouple their service offerings from hardware and rapidly curate and deliver new services over a multi-vendor, open-platform architecture.

Who We Are

AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint.

We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – with current support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, npm, and Python.

We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. We're investing deeply in making Develocity's unique data and decades of domain expertise accessible to both humans and AI agents, with trust, evidence, and explainability at the core of everything we build.

We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community.

Our Values

Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding; we strive to understand diverse viewpoints, problems, and motivations. Before we take action, we ensure we truly grasp the challenges, perspectives, and goals. 

Know the Why: We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused. We take meaningful action with urgency, but never at the expense of thoughtful consideration. 

Innovate & Iterate: We embrace challenges and are not afraid to try new things, even if they might fail. With a deep understanding and a clear purpose, we can develop creative, bold solutions to tackle challenges.

Own the Outcome: We are empowered to take initiative, and we maintain transparency in our work and its outcomes. When we execute, we take responsibility for our decisions, measure the success of our innovations, and learn from the results.

Who You Are

We're building a new SRE team and looking for founding members to help shape how we operate. As a Lead SRE, you'll be a technical and operational leader for reliability across Develocity. You'll help define our SRE vision, set standards for how we operate production services, and mentor other SREs as the team grows. This is a hands-on role with broad influence across engineering, cloud platform, and customer-facing teams.

The SRE team will be responsible for the reliability, performance, and availability of Develocity instances serving paying customers, open-source projects, and public-facing services, plus supporting infrastructure like artifact registries.

You'll work on our internally-built Cloud Application Platform, Kubernetes on AWS, and develop deep expertise in it. When incidents happen, you'll troubleshoot issues across the stack, from application to infrastructure. You'll collaborate with the Cloud Platform team to improve the tooling you depend on, and with engineering teams to build reliability into how we ship software. If you like automating things and hate doing the same task twice, you'll fit in well.

You'll be part of a distributed, remote-first team that values asynchronous communication and written documentation. Strong self-direction and clear communication across time zones are essential.

Responsibilities

  • Operate and maintain all Develocity instances and supporting services in production.
  • Define and evolve SRE standards, practices, and operating models, including on-call, incident response, postmortems, and SLOs.
  • Participate in a follow-the-sun on-call rotation, acting as a technical escalation point for complex or high-severity incidents.
  • Lead incident response and blameless retrospectives, ensuring learnings result in measurable reliability improvements.
  • Set reliability priorities using risk, customer impact, business goals, SLOs, and error budgets.
  • Identify systemic reliability risks and continuously evolve Develocity's SaaS operations as the platform and customer base grow.
  • Lead and influence architectural and design reviews to ensure reliability, scalability, and operability.
  • Drive automation across deployment, upgrades, monitoring, self-healing, recovery, and operational workflows.
  • Build and maintain comprehensive observability for all managed services, including logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting.
  • Own disaster recovery, backups, and business continuity planning and execution.
  • Partner with engineering leadership to balance feature delivery with reliability and operational excellence.
  • Mentor and coach SREs, supporting technical growth and strong operational practices.
  • Help onboard new SREs and contribute to hiring by defining and assessing SRE excellence at Develocity.
  • Communicate clearly with customers during incidents and maintenance windows.
  • Optimize performance, resource utilization, and operational costs.

Minimum qualifications

  • 7+ years in SRE, DevOps, or an equivalent role operating production services at scale.
  • Experience leading reliability initiatives across multiple teams or services.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction without direct authority.
  • Experience designing and operating systems with SLOs and error budgets, and exercising strong judgment in balancing reliability, velocity, and cost.
  • Strong Kubernetes experience in production environments.
  • Cloud infrastructure expertise, preferably AWS (EKS, RDS, S3, EC2).
  • Proficiency with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana) and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
  • Track record of incident management and response in a 24/7 on-call environment.
  • Scripting proficiency (Python, Bash) for automation.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience as a founding or early SRE establishing practices in a growing SaaS organization.
  • Familiarity with Develocity.
  • JVM language experience (Java, Kotlin).
  • Experience with customer-facing and executive-level incident communications.

What We Offer

  • A ground-floor role in a new SRE team - you'll shape how we do things, not inherit someone else's decisions.
  • Real ownership of production systems used by engineers at companies you've heard of.
  • Direct interaction with customers when things go wrong (and when they go right).
  • A culture that values automation over heroics.
  • In-person meetings, such as our annual company offsite and team meetings.
  • Work from home in a remote-first environment.
  • Competitive salaries and equity grants.

Location

  • Remote from anywhere in Europe (GMT). 
  • While our team works remotely and is spread across the globe, we deeply value daily interactions and collaboration.

This role will lead a team of accounting professionals and drive an improvement agenda that scales the function to meet the demands of a fast-paced business — through hands-on ownership of the numbers, critical thinking on every estimate and judgement, and continued development of the function beyond process compliance.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></strong></p> <p><strong><strong>Own the Global General Ledger &amp; Financial Close</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li>Ultimate accountability for the Global GL under US GAAP, including the completeness, accuracy, and timely close of all entities worldwide</li> <li>Build and lead a scalable end-to-end close operating model; set standards, drive consistency, and coach the team to execute with rigour</li> <li>Maintain the quality of balance sheet reconciliations and close deliverables; identify and resolve issues in a timely manner, applying critical evaluation alongside sound accounting and commercial judgement</li> <li>Estimates, accruals, and accounting positions that accurately reflect the pace and trajectory of the business, with the accounting telling the true story behind the numbers</li> <li>Deliver authoritative monthly and quarterly P&amp;L and balance sheet flux analysis — clear on commercial and accounting drivers, risks and opportunities, and material one-off items&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong><strong>Apply and Uphold Technical Accounting Standards</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li>The senior escalation point for accounting matters across the business; research, document, and defend positions on complex and novel issues</li> <li>Provide technical accounting support to business growth and commercial deals, including under ASC 606 (Revenue Recognition) and other judgement-intensive areas</li> <li>Ground accounting in US GAAP principles and policies, with technical rigour as the baseline</li> <li>Evaluate the accounting treatment of commercial arrangements with technical precision and commercial awareness</li> <li>Critical thinking on every judgement call, with standard methodology as a starting point rather than a substitute for judgement&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong><strong>Drive Continuous Improvement</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the improvement agenda — simplify, standardise, and automate close processes, leading with the adoption of AI and enabling technology</li> <li>Partner across Finance, Enterprise Systems and AI Enablement on systems transformation that scales the function for the future</li> <li>Define and embed quality standards, governance frameworks, and documentation requirements across a geographically dispersed team</li> <li>Partner with Finance Operations and the Center of Excellence to maintain clear ownership and consistent execution across time zones (US West Coast, US East Coast, UK, India).&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong><strong>Lead &amp; Develop the Team</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li>Coach and develop a team of accounting professionals, building technical capability and succession depth within the function</li> <li>Create a high-performing team culture grounded in clear expectations, mutual accountability, meaningful development, and direct, honest communication</li> </ul> <p><strong>Partner Across the Organisation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build strong relationships with Finance and Commercial business partners; bring commercial perspective to accounting judgements</li> <li>&nbsp; Represent the Accounting function with confidence and credibility at senior management level&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong><strong>What You’ll Bring</strong></strong></p> <p><strong><strong>Experience &amp; Ways of Working</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li>Deep technical grounding in US GAAP, with the confidence to take and defend positions on complex matters</li> <li>Numbers-first with strong ownership of accuracy — credible at senior stakeholder level, telling the story behind the numbers and comfortable pushing back when warranted</li> <li>A natural change leader with an improvement mindset — builds the case, brings the team along, and delivers lasting change at pace</li> <li>A high-performing people leader, invested in growth and outcomes</li> <li>At ease in fast-paced, global complexity, fluent across both strategic and detailed work</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><strong>Benefits and Perks</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li>Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year</li> <li>Focus on mental health and well-being: <ul> <li>Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth</li> <li>Company-paid subscription to Headspace</li> <li>Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)</li> </ul> </li> <li>Paid parental leave</li> <li>Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday</li> <li>Paid volunteer time</li> <li>Focus on your career growth: <ul> <li>Development Dollars</li> <li>Leadership development</li> <li>Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings</li> </ul> </li> <li>Travel Discounts</li> <li>Employee Resource Groups</li> <li>20 days of paid time off</li> <li>Private health and dental insurance</li> <li>Life and Disability insurance</li> </ul> <p>We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; title: Software Engineer - Synthetic Monitoring | UK | Remote
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at <u><span><a href="http://grafana.com" target="_blank">grafana.com</a></span></u> and follow us on <u><span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/grafana-labs/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a></span></u> and <u><span><a href="https://twitter.com/grafana" target="_blank">X</a></span></u>.</p> <p>We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.</p> <p>You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.</p></div><h3></h3> <p><strong>This is a remote opportunity, and we would be interested in applicants located in Spain, Sweden, UK, Ireland or Germany.&nbsp;</strong></p> <h3>Software Engineer - Synthetic Monitoring</h3> <p><strong>The Opportunity:</strong></p> <p>The Synthetic Monitoring squad builds and operates <a href="https://grafana.com/products/cloud/synthetic-monitoring/">Grafana Cloud Synthetic Monitoring</a>, used by teams globally to proactively verify that their critical user journeys, APIs, and services work as expected - before their customers notice they don't.</p> <p>Synthetic Monitoring is a multi-tenant distributed system implemented in Go, running on Kubernetes across all major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), executing billions of synthetic tests each month from probe locations around the world and from customer-operated private probes.</p> <p>The product is in a scale phase, and our focus is on making Synthetic Monitoring a deeply integrated part of Grafana Cloud: connecting checks to real user experience and cross-product investigation workflows, making check results a trusted signal for AI-assisted workflows, and enabling large organizations to operate the product at enterprise scale on our infrastructure and on their own private probes.</p> <p>The role is full-stack in the real sense: the same engineer who designs how a check execution flows through scheduling, probes, and the telemetry pipeline should also be able to build the workflow that lets a user understand and act on the result.</p> <p>As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. We are looking for Software Engineers who are passionate about building reliable systems and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team! Our stack is Golang, Typescript and React, but we build tools for people using many other stacks.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you'll be doing:</strong></p> <p>As a Software Engineer on the Synthetic Monitoring squad, you will work across the whole system - Go services and agents on the backend, a TypeScript/React application on the frontend and you'll be expected to reason about it as one system, not two halves. Specifically, you will:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Own features end-to-end across the stack</strong>: from API and data model design in Go, through the execution pipeline, to the user-facing workflows in TypeScript/React</li> <li><strong>Design and evolve systems, not just features</strong>: contribute to architectural decisions on scheduling, probe lifecycle, telemetry ingestion, and API design that shape how the product scales</li> <li><strong>Build the cross-product and AI-assisted workflows</strong> that connect Synthetic Monitoring to the wider Grafana Cloud platform</li> <li><strong>Make the product operable at enterprise scale</strong>: the governance and organization primitives that let teams with hundreds of checks manage Synthetic Monitoring as code and with confidence</li> <li><strong>Break down complex, ambiguous problems into incremental deliverables</strong> and iterate quickly based on feedback</li> <li><strong>Ensure quality through testing, observability of your own systems, and documentation</strong>: our checks are something customers alert on, so reliability is a feature</li> <li><strong>Be a part of the team's on-call rotation</strong> and take ownership of the services you're running</li> </ul> <p>We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Technologies you'll work with:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Go (backend services, APIs, and the synthetic monitoring agent)</li> <li>TypeScript / React (the Synthetic Monitoring app in Grafana)</li> <li>Kubernetes across AWS, GCP, and Azure</li> <li>k6 (the execution engine behind scripted and browser checks)</li> <li>Grafana ecosystem (Mimir, Loki, Prometheus)</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You a Great Fit:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You are <strong>comfortable working in a remote-first company</strong>; communication is key.</li> <li>For us, working together means being <strong>collaborative, friendly, kind, and respectful</strong>. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.</p></div><h3></h3> <p><strong>This is a remote opportunity, and we would be interested in applicants located in Spain, Sweden, UK, Ireland or Germany.&nbsp;</strong></p> <h3>Software Engineer - Synthetic Monitoring</h3> <p><strong>The Opportunity:</strong></p> <p>The Synthetic Monitoring squad builds and operates <a href="https://grafana.com/products/cloud/synthetic-monitoring/">Grafana Cloud Synthetic Monitoring</a>, used by teams globally to proactively verify that their critical user journeys, APIs, and services work as expected - before their customers notice they don't.</p> <p>Synthetic Monitoring is a multi-tenant distributed system implemented in Go, running on Kubernetes across all major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), executing billions of synthetic tests each month from probe locations around the world and from customer-operated private probes.</p> <p>The product is in a scale phase, and our focus is on making Synthetic Monitoring a deeply integrated part of Grafana Cloud: connecting checks to real user experience and cross-product investigation workflows, making check results a trusted signal for AI-assisted workflows, and enabling large organizations to operate the product at enterprise scale on our infrastructure and on their own private probes.</p> <p>The role is full-stack in the real sense: the same engineer who designs how a check execution flows through scheduling, probes, and the telemetry pipeline should also be able to build the workflow that lets a user understand and act on the result.</p> <p>As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Technologies you'll work with:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Go (backend services, APIs, and the synthetic monitoring agent)</li> <li>TypeScript / React (the Synthetic Monitoring app in Grafana)</li> <li>Kubernetes across AWS, GCP, and Azure</li> <li>k6 (the execution engine behind scripted and browser checks)</li> <li>Grafana ecosystem (Mimir, Loki, Prometheus)</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You a Great Fit:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You are <strong>comfortable working in a remote-first company</strong>; communication is key.</li> <li>For us, working together means being <strong>collaborative, friendly, kind, and respectful</strong>. We operate by consensus. You can contribute to a discussion, disagree constructively, and commit to the team's decision. You are able to communicate design decisions clearly in written and spoken English.</li> <li><strong>Strong Go, or a path to it.</strong> We build Synthetic Monitoring in Go. Deep experience building and operating production backend systems in another systems language (Rust, Java, C++) translates well; backend experience limited to JavaScript/Node.js runtimes does not.</li> <li><strong>Operational mindset.</strong> You've run what you've built: you've owned production services, understand what it means to carry a pager, and treat reliability and toil reduction as part of the product.</li> <li>You are a <strong>systems thinker</strong>: you reason about how components interact - data flow, failure modes, cost, and operational behavior - not just how a single feature works in isolation.</li> <li><strong>Pragmatism and short feedback loops.</strong> You break complex problems into increments: analyze, design, deliver an MVP, learn, iterate. You are able to design a solution, get feedback, and write a prototype by yourself - the ability to work on your own is crucial.</li> <li>You have a good understanding of <strong>a software development process that takes a user-centered approach</strong>. Senior Brand Marketing Executive 

Soho, London

Hybrid working: 3 days in the office (Tuesday - Thursday)

The Role 

Working within the brand marketing team across Virgin Bet, the Senior Brand Marketing Executive will support the Senior Brand Marketing Manager in planning and executing brand strategies within the markets.

The role will be split across six core areas: 

  • Brand development and guardianship
  • Communications, campaign and media planning
  • Creative development and delivery
  • Co-ordination and execution of sponsorship portfolio
  • Co-ordination and execution of PR and brand
  • Marketing effectiveness measurement 

At LiveScore Group, we're the proud home of three of the most exciting brands in the sports and gaming world: LiveScore, LiveScore Bet and Virgin Bet. A fully owned and operated ecosystem that converges the two worlds of sports media and sports betting. We're proud of the high ratings for our commitment to excellence and fueling fan's passion for sport driving us to the top.

We don't just lead; we innovate. Our cutting-edge products and immersive experiences set the standard, but it's our people who truly make the difference. Every day, our team embody our values: adaptability, teamwork, a fan-driven approach, and an ever-curious mindset that fuels our ambition.

As we scale and continue to create a culture that allows all employees to thrive, we know we need the most talented people with diverse backgrounds, perspectives and skills. If you're good at what you do, come and join us. The more inclusive we are, the more amazing experiences we can create for our users.

Key Responsibilities  

  • Supporting the media planning and delivery of any media deals (in conjunction with the agency)
  • Playing a key role in shaping the creative output of the brand by leading briefing and delivery with internal design teams and external agencies. 
  • Lead the planning and delivery of sponsorship inventory, marketing collateral, and related event-led brand activations with racecourses across the UK.
  • Playing a key role in developing and implementing best-in-class research and measurement frameworks to evaluate brand performance, marketing effectiveness, earned media, sponsorship evaluation and inform strategic decision-making
  • Regularly monitoring and analysing and reporting on marketing performance metrics, including ROI, KPIs, and campaign effectiveness, to assess the success of brand initiatives and identify areas for improvement
  • Taking ownership of updating the master brand budget and associated financial trackers
  • Cultivating and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders, including external partners, agencies, and vendors, to support brand initiatives and drive collaborative opportunities
  • Serving as a key point of contact internally and externally for all brand marketing-related activities, providing expert guidance and support to stakeholders at all levels 

Skills, Knowledge and Experience 

  • Experience within a similar brand/marketing role (client side or agency)
  • Experience/knowledge of the sports betting industry would be advantageous
  • Experienced in managing agencies and working closely with / leading internal teams
  • An effective communicator, well versed in stakeholder management
  • Demonstratable experience of campaign planning and project management
  • Creative experience, working across design based projects
  • Broad channel experience (both media and creative)
  • Strong commercial acumen 

What can we offer? 

  • Company Performance Bonus
  • Flexible Working Agreements where applicable
  • Private Healthcare Scheme + Employee Enhanced Assistance
  • Enhanced Family Leave - Maternity, Shared Parental & Adoption Leave: up to 6 months at full pay and 6 months at half pay. Paternity leave: up to 4 weeks at full pay
  • Subsidised Gym Membership
  • Annual Travel Card Loan & Ride to Work Scheme
  • Life Assurance (x3 salary)
  • Contributory Pension Plan
  • Virgin Family: Giving you access to exclusive Virgin offers and experiences
  • Thursday drinks in the office and regular socials

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Eucalyptus</h3> <p>We're on a mission to make good health last a lifetime. description: <div class="content-intro"><div class="elementToProof"> <p>Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.</p> </div></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a commercially minded Senior Legal Counsel to join our growing legal team and support the company's global sales organisation. This is a highly collaborative role that requires strong partnership with Sales and other business stakeholders, providing pragmatic legal advice while ensuring that legal, regulatory and commercial risks are appropriately identified, assessed and managed.</p> <p>The successful candidate will act as a trusted adviser to the business, helping stakeholders navigate complex customer negotiations while exercising sound judgement regarding risk. They will understand when to find creative solutions to move discussions forward and when it is necessary to escalate, challenge assumptions or recommend alternative approaches to protect the company's interests.</p> <p>This role is ideal for a confident, adaptable lawyer who thrives in a fast-paced software environment, enjoys tackling complex negotiations, and is passionate about helping the business succeed.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build trusted relationships with Sales, Deal Desk, Revenue Operations and other business stakeholders to support customer and channel transactions.</li> <li>Lead the review, drafting and negotiation of a wide range of commercial agreements, including SaaS, BaaS, software, professional services, channel (including aggregator, reseller and GSI relationships) and NDAs.</li> <li>Provide practical, commercially focused legal advice to Sales and business stakeholders, supporting negotiations through clear, pragmatic guidance while identifying, communicating and managing material legal, regulatory, privacy and commercial risks, and advising on compliance requirements, data protection obligations and internal approval processes.</li> <li>Develop practical and defensible solutions to complex contractual and commercial issues, applying sound judgement to balance risk, identify appropriate mitigations and determine when escalation is required.</li> <li>Anticipate potential contractual, legal or operational issues and take proactive steps to address them efficiently and reduce the risk of disputes or delays.</li> <li>Support the development and continuous improvement of contract templates, negotiation playbooks and legal processes, and develop and deliver training and awareness programs to promote best practices and understanding of legal risks, contracting principles and company processes.</li> <li>Collaborate effectively with colleagues across the Legal department and contribute to a positive, high-performing team culture.</li> </ul> <h4>What You’ll Bring</h4> <ul> <li>Qualified lawyer with significant (10-15+ years) post-qualification experience gained in a leading law firm and/or in-house legal department but including significant in-house experience.</li> <li>Strong commercial contracts background, ideally within a software, SaaS, cloud technology or broader technology company.</li> <li>Excellent drafting, contract review and negotiation skills.</li> <li>Extensive experience negotiating complex customer and partner agreements.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to advise business stakeholders in a practical, succinct and commercially focused manner.</li> <li>Experience supporting sales organizations and working closely with commercial stakeholders in a fast-moving environment.</li> <li>Experience advising on privacy and data protection issues arising in commercial technology transactions, including customer contracting requirements relating to the processing, transfer, storage and protection of data.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Bonus Skills</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Strong commercial judgement and ability to assess risk proportionately. Comfortable challenging assumptions and driving constructive discussions to achieve the best outcome for the business.</li> <li>Proactive, self-motivated and willing to take ownership of complex matters from start to finish.</li> <li>Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage a high volume of matters and conflicting priorities.</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain complex legal concepts, articulate recommendations and options, and deliver practical advice that is accessible to a wide range of stakeholders.</li> <li>Sound judgement and the confidence to make risk-based decisions in situations where there may not be a clear precedent or established playbook.</li> </ul> <div class="content-pay-transparency"> <div through Veeam Cares</li> <li>Private medical, dental, and vision insurance with dependent enrolment</li> <li>Life insurance with enhanced coverage and global 24/7 protection</li> <li>Income protection after 26 weeks, covering a portion of salary</li> <li>Defined contribution pension plan with employer match</li> <li>Worldwide travel insurance for business and leisure, with option to enroll dependents</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program with therapy, legal, and financial support, plus online GP services and wellbeing programs</li> <li>Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning</li> </ul> </div> </div> </div> <p>#LI-MP1</p><div description: Deine Aufgaben Retention entscheidet, ob aus dem ersten Kauf eine Beziehung über das ganze Hunde- und Katzenleben wird und genau dieses Spielfeld gehört Dir. Du bekommst Ownership über Lifecycle CRM bei 7 starken Petfood-Marken : Du verantwortest unsere Automations und Kampagnen von der Idee bis zum Go-Live - mit modernen Tools, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und direktem Impact. Du arbeitest selbstständig, triffst Entscheidungen und verbesserst schnell auf Basis von Ergebnissen. Du baust, betreust und optimierst Klaviyo-Flows und -Kampagnen für alle 7 Marken parallel (u.a. Wolfsblut, Herrmann's Manufaktur, pets Premium) - vom Welcome Flow bis zur Reaktivierung. Du verantwortest E-Mail als Kernkanal . Weitere Kanäle wie Print-Mailings, WhatsApp, SMS und RCS bauen wir perspektivisch aus - hier bringst Du kanalübergreifendes Denken ein. Du bringst Maßnahmen eigenständig live und iterierst auf Basis von Ergebnissen. Geschwindigkeit vor Perfektion : Du testest, misst und schärfst schnell nach. Du machst aus Daten konkrete Maßnahmen: RFM, Segmente, Produkt- und Engagement-Daten, Tierprofile, Predictions (Rebuy, CLV, Churn) werden bei Dir zu personalisierter, relevanter Ansprache. Storytelling ist Deine Stärke : Bei Produktion und Skalierung unterstützen Dich moderne Tools und Automatisierung - Du bringst die zündende Hookline, das initiale Design-Briefing und die emotionale Ansprache aufs leere Blatt. Du setzt AI- und Automatisierungstools selbstverständlich ein, um schneller von der Idee zum Live-Test zu kommen und mehr Zeit für Konzept und Creative zu gewinnen. Du kommunizierst Ergebnisse klar und auf den Punkt - intern wie mit unseren Marken-Stakeholdern und du arbeitest als Sparring-Partner auf Augenhöhe.
